\[
V = \text{area of base}\times h
\]

The area of the base can be expressed with the circumference:

\[
c = 2\pi r \;\Longrightarrow\; r = \frac{c}{2\pi}
\]

\[
\text{area}= \pi r^{2}= \pi\left(\frac{c}{2\pi}\right)^{2}
